actor_output.character_response: I discovered I was curious, very friendly, and somehow extremely interested in sharing warmth, which is funny because I was mostly made of the opposite! Right then, I spotted a pinecone sitting nearby and reached for it very carefully... well, Olaf-carefully.

actor_output.character_response: That means a lot to me, truly.
